programme.title: Anglers Digest: St. Lucia
programme.desc: You’ll join us on an informative island tour of volcanoes, waterfalls, gardens, and scenic viewpoints, and even get a chance to party with the friendly natives that are lucky enough to call this paradise their home.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Grand Cayman
programme.desc: IGFA Anglers Digest returns to Grand Cayman to fish and dive in this secluded piece of paradise. Known the world over for its world class scuba diving, those who really know the island come to fish as well.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Turks Caicos 1
programme.desc: Having never been to these amazing Caribbean jewels, I can now see what everyone has raved about the last several years.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Mexico 2
programme.desc: The stunning seaside city of San Jose Del Cabo is featured in this amazing adventure.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: BVI
programme.desc: To the angling world, The U.S. Virgin Islands are famous. St. Thomas is strongly considered one of the hottest blue marlin fishing grounds in the Atlantic.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Tahiti 1
programme.desc: We once again join the amazing crew of the 93 custom catamaran sport fisher, the Ultimate Lady, but this time in the gorgeous Austral Islands of Tahiti.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: San Diego 2
programme.desc: Never a dull moment in my old stomping grounds, San Diego is one of my favorite cities in America and for good reason, great weather, great food, great military heritage, and awesome fishing.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Best Of
programme.desc: This is a remarkable WRAP-UP of the best highlights of the first season of IGFA Anglers Digest on WFN.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Turks Caicos 2
programme.desc: Having never been to these amazing Caribbean jewels, I can now see what everyone has raved about the last several years.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Panama
programme.desc: On the Pacific side of Panama sits an island that has been lost to the test of time… Cebaco…. that is, until James Weise was marlin fishing near it years ago and discovered an untouched fishery.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Guatemala 2
programme.desc: No one in the world would deny that the King's crown of sailfish-fishing belongs to Guatemala.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2612
programme.desc: Småbarnsfaren Micael fra Örebro drikker rundt 1000 liter kaffe i året og bruker nesten 30.000 svenske kroner på energidrikker hvert år. Han drømmer også om å ha råd til å ta med barna på ferie.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2613
programme.desc: Susanne og Andreas bor i Timrå med sine tre barn. Ekteskapet holder på å rakne, men i stedet for å lete etter jobb, spiller Andreas dyre mobilspill flere timer om dagen.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2614
programme.desc: Michaela fra Solna får penger av moren hele tiden, som i gjennomsnitt gir henne 15 000 svenske kroner i måneden. Michaela har bodd alene i fire år, men bare en gang har hun betalt husleien selv.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2615
programme.desc: Markus og Veronica har bare vært sammen i to år, men har allerede giftet seg og fått barn. Veronica fikk seg et sjokk da hun fant ut at Markus har stor gjeld.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2616
programme.desc: 50 år gamle Ola fra Eskilstuna har levd et liv i luksus, og later som at han har mer penger enn han egentlig har. Men under overflaten vokser gjelden seg større for hver dag som går.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2701
programme.desc: Lisa lever tilsynelatende et fantastisk familieliv med to barn, et hus og en samboer. Men under overflaten skjuler det seg en stor gjeld og spilleavhengighet som hun har holdt hemmelig for sin partner.

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: Emma tror de skal krasje og forteller alle sine hemmeligheter til en fremmed på flyet. Hun trodde iallfall at han var en fremmed. Basert på bestselgende roman med samme navn av forfatteren av 'Confessions of a shopaholic' Sophie Kinsella.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: Tank (Dane Cook) står overfor den ultimate vennskapstesten når bestevennen hans (Jason Biggs) vil at han skal ta med ekskjæresten hans (Kate Hudson) ut på en dårlig date, for å understreke at han selv er en bra kjæreste.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: En spøkelseshistorie som spenner over to verdener, med mer enn et århundre fra hverandre. Når 13 år gamle Tolly finner ut at han på mystisk vis kan reise mellom de to, begynner han på et eventyr som låser opp familiehemmeligheter

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton er en ung og vakker men fattig tennistrener som involveres i en rik familie gjennom å trene en av familiemedlemmene. Kjærlighetsaffærer med to kvinner samtidig tvinger ham til å begå en alvorlig forbrytelse.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: The Way Back forteller den sanne historien til syv fangers umulige plan om å flykte fra en sovjetisk fangeleir i 1941. Deres flukt til frihet tar dem på en reise gjennom verdens mest nådeløse landskap.

programme.title: Men Alle Vet
programme.desc: Penélope Cruz og Javier Bardem har hovedrollene i den to ganger Oscarvinnende regissøren Asghar Farhadi's intense drama, hvor hemmeligheter og svik kommer til overflaten i en idyllisk spansk landsby.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: Tully er regissert av Jason Reitman og manuset skrevet av Diablo Cody, duoen som tidligere har laget Juno og Young Adults.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: En kjent skuespiller, som ikke har takket ja til en rolle på fire år, vurderer nå en jobb. Regissørens kusine kjører ham ut av byen til en ranch hvor han vil drive research. På dette idylliske lille stedet blir han helt betatt av en av kassadamene.

programme.title: Simply Irresistible
programme.desc: En varehusleder prøver å motstå å bli forelsket i en ung kvinne, som han mener har magiske krefter etter å ha arvet en restaurant.

programme.title: My Neighbor Adolf
programme.desc: Sør-Amerika, 1960. En ensom og gretten Holocaust-overlevende overbeviser seg selv om at hans nye nabo er Adolf Hitler i egen person. Ingen tar ham alvorlig, så han innleder sin egen etterforskning for å bevise påstanden

programme.title: Boomerang: Housekeeping
programme.desc: Bryson og Ari hjelper David med å sette i stand huset, både i bokstavelig og overført betydning, etter hans 'ingen sex'-regel med Elaine. Til slutt skværer Ari og Bryson opp, men David innser at han trenger tid unna vennene.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Wrath of Grapes
programme.desc: Vanessa og BSA-konene investerer i en vingård. Vanessa er irritert over Marcus manglende interesse og kontakter Bryce fra jusstudiet. Han gir henne den støtte og oppmuntring hun trenger. Laila og Susie Q deltar i Amber Roses tøytemarsj.

programme.title: Games People Play: To Live and Lie in LA
programme.desc: Vanessa skammer seg etter å ha ligget med Bryce, men de fortsetter å tekste. Nia og MJ blir gratulert om nyheten, men Nia får nå likes, lenker og vennskap av Laila etter en kveld på fylla.

programme.title: Games People Play: Reversal of Fortune
programme.desc: I et tilbakeblikk ser vi Kareem som lovende basketspiller. Jamal hjelper ham og Sheila økonomisk mens Kareem rekrutterer. Kareem får et stipend til UCal og får med Marcus som prøvespiller. Jamal lover han skal hjelpe Kareem hvis han greier det.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Blindsided
programme.desc: Mary Jane blir fortvilet når et av hennes intervjuer fører til selvmord. Mark havner i en ubekvem stilling. Niecy frykter at at Dante ikke dukker opp for leveransen hennes og Patrick spekulerer om Helens pleie.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Uber Love
programme.desc: I finalen av første sesong treffer Mary Jane folk hun har såret. Lisa og Mary Janes vennskap settes på prøve.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: People In Glass Houses Shouldn't Throw Fish
programme.desc: Mary Jane har middag og inviterer et gift par som hun og David var vennepar med. Hun gransker også hva hun ønsker seg av livet når hun får vite at den nye dama til David er gravis.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Richard tester en Lexus SC430 mot en Hyunday Coupe, og David Soul fra Starsky And Hutch prøver seg på Top Gear-banen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Jeremy kjører Storbritannia på langs for å se hva som kommer først; stress eller kjedsomhet. Politikeren Boris Johnson prøver seg på Top Gear-banen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Jeremy tester en Renault Clio V6, og en Lotus-ingeniør bygger en byggesettbil (kit car) på kjøkkenet, men overser én viktig ting.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Top Gear-gutta prøver å slå rekordfarten for tauing av en campingvogn, og Jeremy sammenligner en Evo og en Impreza.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 7
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson tester en Hummer - en off-roader basert på jeepen til militærveseenet i USA. Vi får også en titt på en Koenigsegg, Sveriges superbil.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 903
programme.desc: Louisa planlegger en spesiell kveld for Martins bursdag, men det går ikke som planlagt på grunn av AIs overraskelsesfest.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 904
programme.desc: Martin får sin andre vurdering fra legeforeningen, og Buddy forsvinner sporløst. Penhale blir opprørt når hans etterfølger, Mark Mylow, ankommer og prøver å ta over.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 905
programme.desc: Noen har blitt skutt. Penhale starter en etterforskning for å finne gjerningspersonen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 906
programme.desc: Martin og Louisa har sin første fertilitetsavtale, mens Penhale reagerer på et tilfelle av hærverk og får en gratis surfeleksjon.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 907
programme.desc: Fru Tishells unge kusine Sarah Cardy skygger henne på jobb for å få litt arbeidserfaring.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 908
programme.desc: Bryllupsklokkene ringer i Portwenn før Morwenna og Als bryllup. Men noen siste liten problemer truer med spolere dagen.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Deja vu igjen
programme.desc: Michaels slu lillesøster Jennifer Mancini kommer fra New York og flytter inn hos ham og Megan i strandhuset.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Bare Beth
programme.desc: Kyle overrasker Jennifer i strandhuset for å si unnskyld for det avbrutte forholdet. Dette får Michael til å kaste henne ut.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ultimatum og den single jenta
programme.desc: Da Jennifer tar seg jobb som servitør og danser på en strippeklubb, blir Megan bekymret for at hun vil gå samme vei som henne.

programme.title: Melrose Place: På vei
programme.desc: Megan ber Kyle redde Jennifer, og han lar henne bo i leiligheten sin i Melrose til hun finner seg en bedre jobb.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Hemmeligheter og løgner og løgner
programme.desc: Michael og Taylors plan om å ta Peter tar av da Taylor doper ned Peter og later som om han har angrepet henne.

programme.title: Another Tango
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å redde hjembyens mislykkede dansestudio, blir et tidligere par motvillig gjenforent for å delta i en dansekonkurranse.

programme.title: Military Wives
programme.desc: Kvinnene på en militærbase i England forsøker å styre tankene vekk fra deres bekymringer, og ideen om et sangkor tar form. Men ingen av dem hadde forventet at de skulle få opptre i Royal Albert Hall.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Claiming Race
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of a high stakes horse race, Kris falls for Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Kris and her companions track lost horses in the woods while the Ritter family grows emotionally.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Track
programme.desc: Kris investigates the seamy underworld of the race track after Wildfire comes down with colic.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Party
programme.desc: Kris makes an unexpected but crucial discovery about her past when an old friend arrives.

programme.title: Wildfire: Identity
programme.desc: When she gets thrown off a horse and injured, Kris herself realizes that a career as a jockey might come at a high price.

programme.title: Cooking Up Christmas
programme.desc: Når en kokk får den utfordrende oppgaven med å lage mat til en profesjonell idrettsutøver til jul, får hun tilbake troen på seg selv og finner kjærligheten underveis.

programme.title: A New York Christmas Wedding
programme.desc: Bare selve julehelgen kan være vanskelig å håndtere, uten at et bryllup kommer inn i bildet. Men det er det som venter Jennifer Ortiz, som føler presset til å spille rollen som "den perfekte bruden".

programme.title: Christmas in Pine Valley
programme.desc: Natalie eier et såpefirma som hun driver med vennene sine. En dag sender et stort magasin en reporter for å skrive en artikkel om selskapet til Natalie, i troen på at det er en familiebedrift.

programme.title: Two Lovers
programme.desc: En ung mann står overfor en kompleks kjærlighetstrekant når han navigerer mellom to svært ulike kvinner.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: I etterkant av av en verdensomspennende atomkrig er Ann Burden (Margot Robbie) en overlevende. Ann frykter lenge at hun er det eneste gjenlevende mennesket på jorden, inntil hun oppdager noe helt forbløffende: et annen menneske.

programme.title: Trust
programme.desc: Er alle menn utro? Har alle par sidesprang? En sexy og vridd historie om galleristen Brooke og mannen hennes Owen som står overfor eksepsjonelle fristelser - som får uventede resultater. Basert på stykket PUSH av Kristen Lazarian.

programme.title: Scorpion: Sly and the Family Stone
programme.desc: På valgdagen, når demokratiet står på spill, blir Team Scorpion kalt inn når noen prøver å skape kaos i det amerikanske presidentvalget.

programme.title: Scorpion: Mother Load
programme.desc: Når Team Scorpion reiser til Irland for Megans ettårsjubileum, oppdager Walter at en naturkatastrofe i en innsjø i nærheten har skapt en giftig sky som kan drepe alle i landsbyen.

programme.title: Scorpion: This Is the Pits
programme.desc: Paiges mor verver Team Scorpion når hun ved et uhell oppdager en glemt atomreaktor i ferd med å eksplodere.

programme.title: Scorpion: Wreck the Halls
programme.desc: Walter må svømme gjennom de dødelige La Brea-tjæregropene mens teamet hjelper en kvinne som sitter fast i tjæren før hun går tom for oksygen.

programme.title: Scorpion: Wreck the Halls
programme.desc: Det er julaften og Team Scorpions elektronikkfrie ferie på fjellet blir dødelig når de støter på våpensmuglere og Ralph blir kidnappet mens de prøver å rømme.

programme.title: Scorpion: Ice Ca-Cabes
programme.desc: Når et oppdrag i ørkenen resulterer i eksploderende splinter som skader Cabe alvorlig, må Team Scorpion fryse kroppen for å redde livet hans.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When two FBI agents, part of a unit headed by Don's former mentor, are killed during a shootout with bank robbers, the team must investigate what exactly happened. Also, Charlie and Amita worry when Larry opts not to attend a conference in Geneva.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team are called in to investigate who is behind a deadly gambling ring that is running a high-stakes Russian roulette tournament. Also, Don and Charlie become concerned about Alan's financial health.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team searches for a geneticist's daughter who they suspect was abducted by her unstable mother but become more concerned when they think the young girl may be a clone. Also, Charlie and Amita talk about having kids and Liz reveals a dark secret.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When strange, almost paranormal happenings are observed at a decommissioned air base, the spooky occurrences take on a decidedly different tone when the team is brought in to investigate the mystery of a dead woman found there.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team conducts an undercover sting to locate a cyber crime lord, but the operation is foiled by a charming, brilliant hacker whose desire to take over the online black markets puts him in a dangerous online turf war that could lead to murder.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: While tracking down a felon running a heroin ring inside a prison, Agent Ian Edgerton becomes a murder suspect when the informant he meets with ends up dead, sending a desperate Edgerton over the edge when he takes a member of Don's team hostage.

programme.title: Deconstructing Harry
programme.desc: På randen av et nervøst sammenbrudd stormer Lucy inn i leiligheten til Harry Block med de alvorligste hensikter. Harrys tidligere svigerinne er rasende over at han har brukt deres hemmelige forhold som råstoff til sin siste bestselgerroman.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: Hercules in New York
programme.desc: Bannlyst fra Olympus, blir Hercules (Arnold Schwarzenegger) sendt til Jorden, hvor han finner ekte kjærlighet og starter en lysende karriere som kroppsbygger.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: En høyt lovprist og prisbelønnet film, som blant annet fikk prisen for beste regi i Cannes i 1987. Damiel er en ensom engel som streifer omkring i Berlins krigsmerkede gater og trøster dødelige i nød.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Kevin McHale slutter seg til Cheers-gjengen i en basketballkamp mot den rivaliserende baren.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam prøver å få Rebecca tilbake på Cheers etter at hun har fått seg en annen jobb.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Rebecca blir forvirret når Robins eks forteller til pressen at hun er hans sanne kjærlighet.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Ma Clavin flytter inn hos Woody når Cliff vender henne bort.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Norm kjemper for å redde favorittstedet fra å bli revet.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Rebecca planlegger et overraskelsesbesøk til hennes fengslede kjærlighet, Robin.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Illusion

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 703
programme.desc: I Esbjerg har Line og Kristian bygget drømmehuset sitt, trodde de i hvert fall. Åpne rom og store vinduer tiltaler dem ikke lenger, men hva skal de ha i stedet?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 704
programme.desc: For noen år siden solgte Birgitte huset sitt og angret bittert. Nå leier hun og datteren Emma et dyrt nybygg mens de leter etter et hus som ligner på det gamle. Kan ekspertene hjelpe dem?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 705
programme.desc: Pernille og Aron pendler den lange veien fra Odense til Kalundborg hver dag. Drømmen er å bo nærmere jobben, slik at de kan bruke fritiden på noe annet enn å sitte i bilen.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 706
programme.desc: Mie og Jakob har flyttet inn hos Jakobs mor for å spare til drømmehuset. Men er drømmehuset i det hele tatt på markedet? Tobias argumenterer for sin sak, og Mie og Jakob får seg et sjokk.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 707
programme.desc: Både Kristina og Dennis' familier har flyttet til Odense. Paret ønsker å flytte etter, men sliter med å finne tid til å gå på visninger. Tør de stole på ekspertene?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Finger Pane
programme.desc: A serial killer was on the loose and police had to find him before he struck again. Their most promising lead was an unusual one: a bloody fingerprint on the body of one of the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Good as Gold
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Call for Murder
programme.desc: Five people are shot in a cold-blooded robbery. With much of the evidence lost in a fire set by the suspect. An exhaustive manhunt ends in a chilling confrontation with an Eagle Scout turned killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bullet With My Name On It
programme.desc: In his first year on the force, rookie patrol officer Joe Kenda quickly learns the ropes. But when he tries to singlehandedly stop a brawling mob, he finds himself facing down gunfire.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: End of Days
programme.desc: The discovery of a family home littered with corpses tasks Kenda with unspooling the paranoid obsessions of a diseased mind, and forces him to confront his greatest fear.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Mr. Violence
programme.desc: 29yr old Chris is shot in cold blood outside a neighborhood bar. Faced with a trio of suspects, Kenda trusts his gut and makes a controversial decision.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Line Goes Dead
programme.desc: When the severed head of a wife and mother is found, Lt. Joe Kenda uses forensics and interrogation to find both her body and her killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Kenda encounters one of the most horrendous crime scenes of his career, but his hunt for a homicidal maniac leads him to the most unexpected of killers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.desc: Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Night Terrors
programme.desc: When Cheryl Brantner’s children find her dead in her bathtub, Lt. Joe Kenda must decide if this was a soapy accident or something worse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Tighten the Screws
programme.desc: When young Iraq War veteran Curtis Ashley ends up dead, Lt. Joe Kenda has to solve the slaying of a seemingly innocent victim using his keen awareness of the criminal mind.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: When the Music Stops
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran Charles Walker is found unconscious, after a stabbing attack so savage even 45 units of blood couldn’t save his life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Settle the Score
programme.desc: When Johnny Crawford is killed in his easy chair, police are perplexed to learn he may have been shot over a musical instrument. It soon becomes clear the young man wasn’t killed for his own sins.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: Cops: Undercover Blues
programme.desc: Police work a sting that targets drug dealers. An undercover sting uncovers narcotics trafficking. Police respond to a burglary in progress and discover a flop house.

programme.title: Cops: Multiple Identities
programme.desc: Officers recover a baggie of drugs from a crying suspect. A drunk woman hides a second ID in her back pocket. Police stop a vehicle that hit a patrol car.

programme.title: Cops: Donut Pursuit
programme.desc: Officers pursue a truck after a donut shop robbery. Deputies are dispatched when a wife attacks her husband with an unknown object. Deputies respond to a mother and son knife fight.

programme.title: Cops: Kick the Car
programme.desc: Officers intervene when an estranged husband kicks his ex-wife's boyfriend's car. A man claims someone gave him the car he is driving. A woman claims the pills in her purse are not hers.

programme.title: Cops: Maybe it's Sugar
programme.desc: Police conduct a sting operation. A woman is covered in white powder during a traffic stop. Officers spot a young boy on a bike who wandered away from home.

programme.title: Cops: Not a Momma's Boy
programme.desc: Officers are called to fight between a mother and her son. Officers respond to a man on a trolley hurling racial slurs at a passenger. A traffic stop uncovers narcotics in a young man's trunk.

programme.title: Cops: All Aboard!
programme.desc: Officers pursue a truck driving backwards on a freeway. A suspect jumps a train to evade police. A woman claims to be disabled when a pill falls from her pocket.

programme.title: Cops: To the Lighthouse
programme.desc: Officers are called to a restaurant after the owner was held at gunpoint. Police respond to a woman being sexually harassed in a park. A drunk man tells police he is going to buy a lighthouse.

programme.title: Cops: Get a Room
programme.desc: A man claims to be protecting the car he broke into. Officers are called to when a couple gets too friendly while out in public. Police are dispatched when a drunk woman pounds on her neighbor's door.

programme.title: Cops: Connect Four
programme.desc: Deputies assist border patrol in pursuit of a vehicle that has blown both a checkpoint and its tires. A drunk woman is pulled over not knowing she is missing a tire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 102

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry & Hakkespettene
programme.desc: Når basketball-treneren til Piper slutter, blir Henry den nye treneren. Mens han prøver å piske laget i form blir han utfordret av 'The league board' og deres uortodokse regler.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Captain Man: På Ferie
programme.desc: Ray stoler på at Henry og Charlotte beskytter Swellview mens han er i brullup hos sin kusine. Problemer oppstår når de må ordne ting på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: The Time Jerker
programme.desc: Når Kid Danger og Captain Man sloss mot Time Bandit faller Kid Danger tilfeldigvis inn i tidsmaskinen til Time Bandit og opplever den samme dagen om og om igjen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Luksus Biff
programme.desc: Med en invitasjon til den beste restauranten i Swellview bestemmer Henry seg for å ta med seg sjefen sin, Ray. Det blir mer komplisert enn han forventet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Sjalue Henry
programme.desc: Etter at Jasper blir hyllet som en lokal helt blir Henry sjalu for at Kid Danger blir takket og ikke ham selv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jul med Danger
programme.desc: Når Captain Man blir arrestert for tyveri blir han nødt til å tilbringe julen i fengsel. Henry og Charlotte må prøve å hjelpe Captain Man så han får en fin jul i fengselet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uskadelige Henry: Del 1
programme.desc: Når Kid Danger blir skadet på et oppdrag, bestemmer Henry seg for å bli like uovervinnelig som Captain Man. Men ting blir ikke helt som Henry hadde håpet at det skulle bli.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uskadelig Henry Del 2
programme.desc: Når Henry får en uventet skavank, må han skjule den for familien mens gjengen jobber med å få ham tilbake til normalen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tekst, Løgner og Video
programme.desc: Når en video av Henry og Ray, der de blir til Kid Danger og Captain Man, kommer ut må Henry kjempe for å få den tilbake slik at ikke hemmeligheten hans blir avslørt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Motsatt Univers
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte blir transportert inn i et omvendt univers hvor Ray og Schwoz er onde og prøver å ødelegge Piper. De må stoppe onde Ray og onde Schwoz og finne ut hvordan de skal klare og komme seg tilbake.

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant
programme.desc: Gratulerer med dagen! Vår kanalen har fått en 25 års logo får å feire bursdagen til vår kule favorite svamp! Her finner du eventyrene og bestrebelsene til SvampeBob Firkant og vennene hans i vann i den fiktive undervannsbyen Bikini Bunnen.

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant
programme.desc: Gratulerer med dagen! Vår kanalen har fått en 25 års logo får å feire bursdagen til vår kule favorite svamp! Her finner du eventyrene og bestrebelsene til SvampeBob Firkant og vennene hans i vann i den fiktive undervannsbyen Bikini Bunnen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Skoledagen / Valpene Skrur på Lyset
programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol må finne igjen skolesekken som Alec har mistet før skolebussen kommer. // Chase har bursdag, men en storm fører til at strømmen går. Paw Patrol må fikse strømmen og redde bursdagsfesten for Chase.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene redder Cowboyfesten / Valpene redder Cali
programme.desc: Det er cowboyfest i byen, men når en flokk kuer rømmer fra togvognen, må Ryder og Paw Patrol redde festen. // Alex vil gjerne være med i Paw Patrol, men han ødelegger mer enn han hjelper til når de skal redde Cali fra låven til Yumi bonde.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Bukta / Valpene Redder en Goodway
programme.desc: En oljetanker har sprunget lekk i Adventure-bukta og Ryder og Paw Patrol må renske opp oljen. // Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjelpe ordfører Goodway med å få opp en berømt statue som har havnet i vannet.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Sitter Tvillingvakt / Valpene Redder Fyrverkeriet
programme.desc: Ordfører Goodway ringer Paw Patrol for å få dem til å redde nevøen og niesen hennes ned fra et tre og for at de skal passe på tvillingene for en dag // Ordfører Goodway forventer en eske med fyrverkeri, men mottar en pakke med grisunger!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Hav-Valp
programme.desc: Når Valpene og Cap'N Turbot er ute under den veldig sjeldne Magiske Hav Månen, begynner magiske ting å skje. Lokket av den mystiske Hav-Valp sangen blir PAW Patrol plutselig forvandlet til Hav-Valper.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene på Glatta / Valpene Redder en Basketballkamp
programme.desc: En vinterstorm skaper trøbbel for hele Adventure Bukta. // Ordfører Goodway utfordrer ordfører Humdinger's basketballag til en kamp. Det eneste Ordfører Goodway mangler er et, Basketballag!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Pizza / Valpene Redder Skye
programme.desc: Alex og Herr Porter leverer pizzadeig til et stort selskap når de mister kontrollen over bilen. Valpene må redde dem! // Skye er på vei til Jake-fjellet når hun krasjer i snøen. Ryder ringer Everest for å redde dagen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Pingvinene / Valpene Redder en Delfinunge
programme.desc: Noen har sveipet fisk av båten til Cap'n Turbot, så han kaller på Ryder og PAW Patrol som hjelper ham i etterforskningen. // Ved hjelp av sitt nye spion utstyr, inspiserer Chase båten og under dekk oppdager han en gruppe Pingviner.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Walinda / Valpene Redder et Stort Bein
programme.desc: Paw Patrol planlegger en spesiell feiring av Wally. Når han ikke kommer, må de finne hans spesielle venn Walinda. // Under Cap'n Turbots arkeologiske utgraving kommer et dinosaurbein til syne etter et steinras.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Elefantfamilie / Valpene og de Slemme Kattene
programme.desc: Valpenes kjøretur over savannen blir til en redningsaksjon og en familiegjenforening for en elefantfamilie. // Valpene må redde Adventure bukta fra de slemme kattene for å vinne en stor premie.

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror de kysset
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin sparket, overtar miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og innfører strenge regler. Og Spencer leier en gammel rodeostjerne til å lære ham å ri på en mekanisk okse.

programme.title: iCarly: iSpeed Date
programme.desc: Så mange gutter dukker opp til 'ta Carly med på fest'-konkurransen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for å møte dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et merkelig treningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.title: iCarly: Stjernehjelp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie skal lage en musikkvideo til en popstjernes comeback, oppdager de at popstjernen er ute av form og talentløs. Og Spencer oppdager at kvinnen han dater er Gibbys mor.

programme.title: iCarly: Livredderen
programme.desc: Når Freddie redder livet til Carly, forelsker Carly seg i ham. Sam og Spencer kjemper mot hverandre i et painball-spill som heter Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts tapte kjærlighet
programme.desc: Når gjengen oppdager at Lewbert engang var en lykkelig ung mann som var forlovet med en vakker kvinne, setter de seg fore å gjenforene det adskilte paret.

programme.title: iCarly: Missekonkurransen
programme.desc: Sam avslører overfor Carly og Freddie at hun deltok i skjønnhetskonkurranser som liten. Da hun finner ut at hennes rival skal konkurrere i Seattle, overbeviser hun Carly om å stille opp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: Etter at Sam plutselig må i fengsel, lover Carly og Freddie dyrt og hellig å ikke avlyse nettshowet ettersom faren hennes skal se det. Carly ber Spencer om hjelp, men det blir vanskelig, for han skal på date.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Etter moroa på 4. juli, fortsetter Jenna og Matty å fyre opp under vennskapet ved å holde fest for Jake - i det minste inntil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med å avsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver å velge mellom suksess hos Idea Bin og sitt vennskap med Matty. Jake opplever et uventet intimt møte, og Sadie og Sergio driver plutselig og sparrer mer enn noen gang.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder seg som barnevakt og mottar uventet hjelp av Matty. I mens får Lissa vite hva som er hemmeligheten ved å være en Palos Hills-mamma, og Tamara og Sadie får mer en nok på en rik tenårings strandselskap.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tar forholdet med Luke ett nivå opp og Tamaras gjeld kommer tilbake og biter henne i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: En krangel med Luke presser Jenna til å bli med på leirgjenforeningen og dermed mot å gjenoppta kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjelper Jenna til å få et viktig møte på SCU, Tamara er ærlig mot Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjelp til å komme inn igjen i varmen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1003

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 427

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 428
programme.desc: Siste dag før finaleuka setter i gang på Camp Kulinaris og i dag må en reise hjem. Etter gårsdagens mislykkede servering er restaurantsjef Benedicte automatisk førstelærling.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 429
programme.desc: Det er første dag i finaleuka på Camp Kulinaris. Mia, Terje, Fetisha Ole og Hasse skal I dag gjennom to konkurranser. Hvor allerede den første konkurransen blir viktig inn mot morgendagen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 430
programme.desc: Det er dag to i finaleuka på Camp Kulinaris. Etter gårsdagens to konkurranser har deltakerne blitt rangert fra en til fem. Denne rangering blir viktig før dagens test, der taperen må reise hjem.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 431
programme.desc: Det er dag tre av finaleuka og 4 deltakere gjenstår. To nye konkurranser venter, stikkord: kommunikasjon og smaksløker. Igjen ender dagen med at en deltaker til må reise hjem.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 432
programme.desc: Nest siste dag av årets Camp Kulinaris. Tre deltakere og to finalebilletter ligger i potten. I dagens første konkurranse skal nok en gang smaksløkene settes på prøve.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 908

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1002

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1008

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1010

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1026

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1007

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 201

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 401

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 804

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 502

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 905

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2603

programme.title: Luksusfellen
programme.desc: Roy Erik kjøper og selger klokker annenhver uke og ekspertene har aldri sett liknende sløsing. Han kjøper på impuls og selger med tap. Han kan se langt etter drømmehuset med sin kjøpshistorikk.

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, military pilots allegedly not only saw UFOs but engaged them. The team gets special access to ex-pilots in Iran and Peru who followed strange objects.

programme.title: UFO Hunters II: Tales from the Universe
programme.desc: Italienske ufologer utforsker spor etter romvesener i historie og folklore. Har vi blitt overvåket siden oldtiden? Dette programmet vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Belgian UFO
programme.desc: I denne programserie ser vi på uløste mysterier. Denne episode inkluderer: Belgian UFO, (Del 1 & 2), UD: I.D. Swap, Brenda's Fire og Philip Breen & UD. Dette programmet vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Midnight Sun
programme.desc: The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Still Valley
programme.desc: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Stranger in Possum Meadows
programme.desc: A young boy playing in a field meets an old man who is really an alien collecting specimens to bring back to his planet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Street of Shadows
programme.desc: While taking a walk in a wealthy neighborhood, an unemployed man living in a shelter experiences an unusual transformation

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Something in the Walls
programme.desc: A doctor arrives at his new job in a sanitarium. He discovers the case of a woman who is terribly frightened of things that appear on her walls.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Room 2426
programme.desc: Martin Decker is confined to a special room for acts and thoughts against the state. They want the formula for a weapon he does not want to reveal. Escape for Martin comes from the mind.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jungle
programme.desc: Alan Richards plans to build a dam in Africa on a tribe's ancestral land. The tribe's witch doctor puts a curse on him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programme.desc: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Seasons Of Belief
programme.desc: A couple “entertains" their children on Christmas Eve with a horrific tale of a creature known as the "Grither," but the joke is soon on them.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Miss May Dusa
programme.desc: A robber accidentally brings a mannequin to life - its gaze turns him into a statue. The now-living mannequin flees into the night, unaware of her powers or the harm she can bring.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Milkman Cometh
programme.desc: A man, Garry, hears from his neighbor a bizarre tale of how the unseen neighborhood milkman grants wishes to anyone who leaves their request in the empty bottles to be picked up. Garry tries it for himself and soon finds his every wish granted.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: My Ghostwriter - The Vampire
programme.desc: Hack writer Peter, writing worse and worse vampire stories, buys a coffin for inspiration and finds it occupied by Count Draco. Peter manages to protect himself, and the two strike a deal.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: My Own Place
programme.desc: Laura, a desperate woman, tries to get an apartment by herself but is forced to take in Ram, an immigrant from Calcutta. When Ram dies partly due to her involvement, Laura finds that she has inherited an entire family of ghostly Hindus.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Red Leader
programme.desc: A crooked tycoon makes a deal with the Devil in return for power and wealth.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Everybody Needs A Little Love
programme.desc: Robert, a lonely divorced man, fixated on a mannequin, but the question soon becomes - is the mannequin alive?

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Auld Acquaintances
programme.desc: Two long-lived witches, Elizabeth and Mary, vie once more over an amulet in the modern day that they agreed to share hundreds of years ago.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Social Climber
programme.desc: A shoemaker's apprentice discovers a strange power when he finds he can step into other peoples' lives simply by putting on their shoes.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Swap
programme.desc: Anna Belle's plot to murder her husband to gain his money backfires with unpleasant results.

programme.title: Grantchester: Episode 206
programme.desc: Sidney ønsker å glemme, og Sam ønsker tilgivelse. Foreldrene til en avdød datter søker hevn, og Amanda oppsøker Sidney.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 201
programme.desc: Jodi strever mellom sannheten og Beckys følelser når hun innser at Seans besøk ikke er så uskyldig. Tess' hampavling holder henne borte fra Alex, mens Claires flørting med Peter tar en ny vending.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 202
programme.desc: Under en kaninpest dukker en baby opp på dørstokken til Alex. Peter og Claire sliter med å fornekte følelsene for hverandre.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 203
programme.desc: Becky blir forfulgt av noen som gir henne skylden for at livet hennes falt sammen. Claire og Peter blir tettere, og Tess finner en overraskende alliert i Nick.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 204
programme.desc: Claire og Nick ødelegger en viktig vanntilførsel midt under en tørkeperiode. Snart blir tvisten personlig, og gamle venner blir fiender.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1107
programme.desc: En gjeng gourmetkokker møter en gjeng fryktløse fartsfantomer. Christer Rødseth, Christoffer Davidsen og Trond Moi møter rallyfører Mads Østberg, artist Raylee og snøscooterkjører Marie Sandberg.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Det er lagspillere mot individualister som skal i duell. På det røde fotballaget møter vi Jan Gunnar Solli, Solveig Guldbrandsen og Tobias Becks. På det blå laget finner vi Rasmus Wold, Genette Våge og Victoria Tolaas.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1101
programme.desc: Det er klart for en intens og spektakulær kamp med Kristin Gjelsvik, Dennis Poppe og Oskar Westerlin på det røde laget, mot Herman Dahl, Emilie "Emzia" Helgesen og Christopher Robin Omdahl på det blå laget.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1102
programme.desc: Det er styrke, utholdenhet og akrobatikk som står i fokus når Anders Aukland, Martine Ek Hagen og Marthe Kristoffersen skal kjempe mot Lars Berger, Jonathan Nordbotten og Espen Jansen om den store gullskatten.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1103
programme.desc: Dagens kamp står mellom Abu Hussain, Mayoo Indiran og Stian Sandø på det blå laget, og Alexandra Joner, Lene Orvik og Sebastian Solberg på det røde laget.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Etterpåklokskap
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbake og denne gangen har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Den fattige ungen
programme.desc: Kennys foreldre blir arrestert og han plasseres i fosterhjem - så nå er Cartman det fattigste barnet på skolen! I mellomtiden kommer en mystisk figur fra fortiden tilbake.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg
programme.desc: Ført an av 'Mysterion', jobber 'Coon' og vennene hans med å hjelpe folk i Gulfen. Og 'Coon' er ute etter hevn.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingelskeren
programme.desc: Barbrady ber guttene om hjelp til å løse en sak, og Cartman lar seg rive med av sin nye autoritet.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en analundersøkelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer at han møter et romvesen, men de andre guttene er sikre på at drømmen var virkelighet.

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himmelen
programme.desc: Guttene bryter seg inn for å stjele urnen med Kennys aske.

programme.title: South Park: Hyllusinasjoner
programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Kassebilderby
programme.desc: Randy og Stan oppdager uforvarende warphastighet, så nå kan Jorden bli opptatt i Det galaktiske planetforbund, men en romgangster truer med å ødelegge alt.

programme.title: South Park: Rumpeburgere
programme.desc: Stans eksistensielle livskrise fortsetter, og Cartman går inn i burgerbransjen med en superspesiell hemmelig ingrediens.

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno
programme.desc: Gutta bruker spillet Minecraft for å prøve å forhindre at foreldrene deres skader hverandre.

programme.title: South Park: Penger og gull
programme.desc: Stan bestefar kjøper et overpriset smykke til ham fra J & G handelsnettverk. Stan innser at han må redde sårbare seniorer fra handelsnettverk. Cartman starter sitt eget handelsnettverk når han ser hvor godt J & G handlenettverks taktikk fungerer.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Når gutta reiser til Aspen for å stå på ski for første gang, legger Stan seg ut med lokalbefolkningen og blir utfordret til et løp.

programme.title: South Park: Freemium er ikke gratis
programme.desc: Stan blir avhengig av det nye mobilspillet med Terrance og Phillip.

programme.title: South Park: Skogsdyrenes jul
programme.desc: Julenissen må drepe alle onde dyr i South Park og redde verden etter at Stan narres til å hjelpe dem med fødselen til frelseren deres.

programme.title: South Park: South Parks fantastiske påskespesial
programme.desc: Stan vil finne opprinnelsen til malte påskeegg og oppdager en hemmelighet om den katolske kirken.

programme.title: South Park: Du har null venner
programme.desc: Mot bedre vitende, blir Stan med på Facebook og blir en sosialt nettworkende 'juggernaut', noe som forårsaker at han selv blir sugd inn i websiden.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Stan og Kyle står overfor sitt store gjennombrudd med Guitar Hero-ferdighetene sine. Manageren deres overbeviser Stan om at Kyle holder ham tilbake, og skaper spenninger mellom dem.

programme.title: South Park: Heia Gud XII
programme.desc: Cartman fryser seg ned og våkner opp 500 år inn i fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Barn med rødt hår
programme.desc: Cartman får 'gingervitus' og tar opp kampen mot forfølgelsen av rødhårede.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman suger
programme.desc: Butters blir sett i en kompromitterende stilling med Cartman og sendes til omvendingsleir for homofile. Cartman prøver å få tilbake et bilde av det som skjedde.

programme.title: South Park: Menneskebjørngrisen
programme.desc: Guttene hjelper tidligere visepresident Al Gore i jakten på oppmerksomhet og blir innesperret i en hule. Cartman prøver å finne veien ut og oppdager en skatt.

programme.title: South Park: Buddha Box
programme.desc: Cartman har fått en angstdiagnose.

programme.title: South Park: Zimmermans verdenskrig
programme.desc: Cartman anser Token for å være en trussel mot hele menneskeheten.

programme.title: South Park: Fattig og dum
programme.desc: Cartmans nye ambisjon her i livet er at han vil bli en NASCAR-kjører. Klarer Cartman å vinne sitt livs race?

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans teite hatkriminalitet 2000
programme.desc: FBI etterforsker Cartman for hatkriminalitet etter at han har kastet en stein på Token.

programme.title: South Park: City People
programme.desc: Da moren får en ny jobb blir Cartman misfornøyd.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Cartmans mor innser at hun ikke har kontroll på sønnen sin og søker eksperthjelp fra hundehviskeren Cesar Millan.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet I
programme.desc: Guttene kommer til et magisk land der hele verdens fantasi ligger foran dem, men terroristplaner truer med å ødelegge alt sammen.

programme.title: South Park: Vesenet
programme.desc: Kyles fetter Kyle Schwartz flytter til South Park på grunn av morens helseproblemer. Til å begynne med er Kyle glad for besøket, men det går ikke lang tid før 'Kyle 2' begynner å irritere ham.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrisons nye vakre vagina
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison skifter kjønn, og Kyle får en 'uvanlig' operasjon som gjør ham høy og sprek nok til å komme på basketballaget.

programme.title: South Park: Se opp for de selvgode!
programme.desc: South Parks innbyggere kjøper hybridbiler, men idet folk begynner å føle seg fornøyde fordi de redder verden, samler en mørk sky seg over byen.

programme.title: South Park: Det er en Jersey-greie
programme.desc: Byen South Park må forsvare seg mot å bli overkjørt av New Jersey og realitystjernene derfra.

programme.title: South Park: HumancentiPad
programme.desc: Kyle blir kidnappet av Apple etter å ha unngått å lese et kontraktstillegg. Apple har store planer med ham, og det må bli gutta som redder ham.

programme.title: South Park: Tiss
programme.desc: Høyt urininnhold i svømmebassenget fører til en katastrofe som ødelegger guttas dag, særlig Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får fritt utløp igjen.

programme.title: South Park: Crackbabyforbundet
programme.desc: Da Kyle oppdager at Cartman deltar frivillig med 'crack babies' på lokalsykehuset blir han mistenksom. Og hvilken rolle spiller Slash (fra Guns 'n Roses) i alt dette?

programme.title: South Park: Chef går amok
programme.desc: Chef mener South Parks flagg er rasistisk. Stan og Kyle leder tilhengerne av det gamle flagget, mens Wendy og Cartman støtter dem som ønsker et nytt flagg.

programme.title: South Park: Glade hologram
programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Pipe Dream
programme.desc: Ryan's father Ray, a small-time inventor, rolls into town and announces that he's achieved great financial success and is planning to finally marry.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: We the People
programme.desc: Mrs. Hinkle, Mary, Lucy, and even Matt and Shana lend a hand to their industrious younger siblings with the paper route.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: The Voice
programme.desc: The custodian at Simon's school tells the Reverend that he's been hearing the voice of God.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: All Dogs Go To Heaven
programme.desc: Matt's trying to look out for his younger sister, but Mary is fighting for her right to party.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: There Goes the Bride (Part 1)
programme.desc: In the first of this two-part episode, Heather is back in town and getting married, but Matt finds out an awful secret about her fiance.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: There Goes the Bride (Part 2)
programme.desc: In the dramatic conclusion of this two-part episode, Heather finds out the ugly truth about her betrothed, while Matt tries to convince Shana that he still loves her.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 2
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Bill and Antionette from Newport, who share their home with their 3 cats. They admit they’ve not deep cleaned their home since they moved in.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 3
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of married couple Lynne and Keith from Chudleigh in South Devon whose house hasn’t had a deep clean since they moved in nearly 20 years ago.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 4
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Anita from Manchester, who’s house is overrun with her 3 cats who make a mess wherever they like.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: Ekstreme samlere: Episode 4
programme.desc: In Liverpool, the Bells are a family at war over hoarding. Mum Betty and son Richard are happy to live in their mess, but son in law Keith is determined that things must change. Can they change the habit of a lifetime and part with their possessions?

programme.title: Ekstreme samlere: Episode 5

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.desc: Følg med huseiere når de tar valget om å endre livsstilen sin og bytte ut bylivet med det rolige livet på landet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Disrobed
programme.desc: The crime scene was especially violent: a husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom. Was their 16-year-old daughter complicit?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: About Face
programme.desc: A human skeleton was discovered in the North Carolina marshlands. When investigators learned she'd been dead for 18 months, they knew it would be difficult to find out who she was, let alone who killed her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Kenda encounters one of the most horrendous crime scenes of his career, but his hunt for a homicidal maniac leads him to the most unexpected of killers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Mr. LA
programme.desc: A young man tries to flee a violent scene, but is shot dead behind the wheel of his car. A peculiar clue puts Kenda hot on the heels of a self-styled gangster with revenge on his mind.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Two best friends are gunned down on a dark residential street. When a string of disappointments threaten to derail the case, Kenda enlists the help of an old acquaintance.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bump In the Night
programme.desc: When a pretty, young pilot is found in bed, bound and with a bullet in her head, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine if this was a random assault or payback for something that happened in the skies.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Falling
programme.desc: When a family of four is brutally murdered, it sends a shockwave of fear through the town. Police believe they have a spree killer on their hands, until Lt. Joe Kenda discovers a gruesome connection.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire
programme.desc: The Northern Lights are more than just beautiful; they tell us about the make up of our planet, our sun, and may even be a signpost for the possibility of life on other planets.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 5: Space Missions
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987 the New Mexico Penitentiary housed hundreds of violent offenders, rapists, killers, men the juries put behind bars to protect society. On July fourth, seven of those men escaped.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar. The gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Etna, New Hampshire is a small town. It's the kind of place where people trust their neighbors and leave their doors unlocked. A double murder shattered that trust and left the entire community terrified.
